title: He Built a Wall of Iron, Then Gave the Credit Away

meta.name: v5_k18_14_the-barrier
meta.title: He Built a Wall of Iron, Then Gave the Credit Away

lines.text: He built an iron wall, then gave the credit away.
A people ask Dhul-Qarnayn for a barrier against Gog and Magog.
That in which my Lord has established me is better [than what you offer], but assist me with strength; I will make between you and them a dam.

quran.ar: مَا مَكَّنِّی فِیهِ رَبِّی خَیۡرࣱ فَأَعِینُونِی بِقُوَّةٍ أَجۡعَلۡ بَیۡنَكُمۡ وَبَیۡنَهُمۡ رَدۡمًا

lines.text: This is a mercy from my Lord; but when the promise of my Lord comes, He will make it level, and ever is the promise of my Lord true.

quran.ar: هَـٰذَا رَحۡمَةࣱ مِّن رَّبِّیۖ فَإِذَا جَاۤءَ وَعۡدُ رَبِّی جَعَلَهُۥ دَكَّاۤءَۖ وَكَانَ وَعۡدُ رَبِّی حَقࣰّا
